items.title: VELTRIX 0.8.2 is available
items.summary: VELTRIX 0.8.2 fixes the Windows no-window startup crash, keeps the Microsoft TLS runtime fix, and adds startup diagnostics and recovery for malformed launcher settings.

items.title: Official VELTRIX project page launched
items.summary: The public project page contains launcher information, authentication details, project status, news and the current download.

items.title: Minecraft Services approval in progress
items.summary: Microsoft OAuth and Xbox/XSTS authentication are integrated. The VELTRIX application is being submitted for Minecraft Services approval.
